title: Option to vocalize glucose readings at longer intervals.
symptom: The user wants to have spoken glucose readings but at longer intervals than every 5 minutes, and also wants the option to speak alerts instead of alarm noise.
fix: The developer added new options in the 'Speak Readings' section to set the minimum number of minutes between readings or the minimum change in glucose value. The user confirmed it works after setting it to roughly 17 minutes.
settings_changed: Speak Readings minimum minutes → roughly 17 minutes
evidence_quote: Here you can set the minimum number of minutes between each reading or the minimum change. If either thing happens, eg glucose changes vs previous spoken reading by more than the amount set or more than the specified number of minutes pass then the reading will be spoken.
